SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.name, r.parent_id, r.res_key, r.type, r.res_url, r.order_no, r.icon, r.is_hide, r.description FROM t_sys_resources r
INNER JOIN t_sys_role_action ra ON ra.res_id = r.id INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = ra.role_id
r.is_hide = 0
AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY r.parent_id, r.order_no, r.id
